scope: All 2000 exported graphs analysed independently; no pooling and no graph selection by fit quality
estimation: Exact discrete power-law MLE; threshold minimizes igraph implementation discrete KS discrepancy (model P(K<k) versus empirical left CDF at observed degrees), igraph 0.11.9 / C core 0.10.16
bootstrap: Semiparametric empirical head and fitted discrete-zeta tail; refit both alpha and xmin in every replicate; strict D_boot > D_observed exceedance
seed: First 8 bytes of SHA256('degree-distribution-v1:' + graph_id), big endian; independent seeded Python random.Random passed to igraph
monte_carlo_interval: Exact two-sided Clopper-Pearson binomial interval for bootstrap exceedance probability
alternative_support: Same observations k >= fitted power-law xmin; no fitted or sample-maximum upper truncation
lognormal_definition: Rounded discrete lognormal with probability over integer-width bins, using powerlaw 2.0.0 discrete_normalization='round'
comparison: Official powerlaw non-nested likelihood-ratio statistic and nominal asymptotic p; same-tail per-observation likelihoods; stable direct Hurwitz-zeta normalization for power law
alternative_validity: Flag library noise_flag, out-of-range/nonfinite parameters, nonpositive sigma or Lambda, floor-clipped/nonfinite/nonpositive probabilities, zero/nonfinite likelihood-difference variance, nonfinite comparison; retain failed outcomes without selecting another fit
